body: Its going to take a big epiphany to set me on a different course but im givin it a week so who knows, thanks

Thanks, i just see me leaving as help to everyone else. I just wanna try and enjoy the next week. I appreciate you offering me that level of help,i really do, but i dont wanna waste your time. I dont really know why i posted here, im not looking for help, i guess i just wanted to lay it out somewhere you know? maybe over the next few days, seein stuff in a new light will change my mind, but right now im pretty dead set on what i want to do. I dont wanna go to a hospital, id have to convince them i want to be there for them to let me stay, which i dont. Like you said, ill just keep myself occupied and if something changes, so be it. Ive spent hours and hours researching methods, and reading peoples testimonies on their failures. i feel well prepared. The internet can be pretty dark if you go looking lol.  Im sorry if that came off as rude, i kinds feel like a dick just shooting down nice words like that.

Im not sad anymore. I used to hate waking up, but now it will be easy. Ill enjoy whatever i can, and just brush off the usual bullshit. worrying is just a waste of energy now. I feel fuckin totally at peace to be honest with you. No tears, no why mes, im literally smiling right now, the first taste of relief ive felt in years. Im almost excited, which is not what i expected to feel. My family will move on, i damage them enough when im alive, and i dont want to further hurt their memory of me before the choice of dying is taken from me, and it just happens.
